gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-display: Grandstander is all bold, wiry lines with short ascenders and a tall middle. Noto Sans Display follows in a friendly sans-serif, its big lowercase zone making each word feel generous and approachable beside the louder heading.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-port-lligat-sans: Port Lligat Sans packs its letters tightly, like pins in a cushion. Grandstander bends single-wire strokes into something loud and expressive up top, while the sans below keeps its bowls unfinished and its capitals barely taller than the lowercase.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-ramabhadra: Chunky, cheerful letters up top, with Grandstander drawing every stroke flat and uniform, no brush swelling, while Ramabhadra sits underneath in a sans-serif with a prominent x-height. Text stays crisp.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-saira-semi-conden: Grandstander draws its bold, expressive letters with lines that never swell, and keeps its ascenders short above a tall x-height. Saira Semi Condensed just hums along below it in a sans that looks magnified.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-smooch-sans: Expressive is the right word for Grandstander, whose strokes look like drawn wire with tall, short-ascender letters. And Smooch Sans gives it a counterpart that is tightly packed, with a high midline and a generously open s.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-tiny5: Tiny5 is a tall-bodied sans-serif, so its ascenders look short. Grandstander brings the bold, expressive curves, each as thick as a drawn thread, and that gap between loud and tidy is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-truculenta: Approachable is the first word for Grandstander, bold and wiry with short ascenders over a tall x-height. And Truculenta follows in a plain sans that crowds its letters into a compact line while keeping its rounded forms clearly open.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-ubuntu: Grandstander is bold and wiry, drawn with constant-width lines. Ubuntu hums softly below in a plain sans with a lofty lowercase band, so the loud heading hands off smoothly to a modern, professional text.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-victor-mono: Grandstander is bold and expressive, with plain lines and short ascenders. Victor Mono, a monospace, is the precise one, with loosely spaced glyphs and bowls left unfinished, so each font does a clearly different job.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-viga: Viga reads in a neutral, hairline-free sans where capitals barely rise above their neighbors. But Grandstander brings the personality with bold, constant-width lines, while Viga simply keeps the text steady and professional.
